blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Machine learning models trained on data with imbalanced subgroup distributions often achieve high overall test performance but suffer from performance disparities in subgroups Geirhos et al. (2020) ; Koh et al. (2021) ; Quiñonero-Candela et al. (2022) or favor the majority groups He and Garcia (2009) ; Johnson and Khoshgoftaar (2019) ; Zhang et al. (2023) .
This challenge has been widely studied under topics such as spurious correlation Arjovsky et al. (2019) ; Sagawa et al. (2020b) ; Geirhos et al. (2020) , fairness Hardt et al. (2016) ; Kearns et al. (2018) ; Mehrabi et al. (2021) , and class imbalance Krawczyk (2016) ; Lin et al. (2017) ; Cui et al. (2019) in machine learning, where the goal is to ensure robust generalization across subgroups or to improve the performance on the worst-performing group. One common framework to encompass the above studies is the subpopulation shift Koh et al. (2021) ; Yang et al. (2023) , which refers to discrepancies between the subgroup proportions in the training and test data. In many cases, the evaluation focuses on the worst-group performance Sagawa et al. (2020a) or the overall performance on balanced test data Yang et al. (2023) , where models trained and evaluated on data with subpopulation shifts are likely to fail Koh et al. (2021) .

blocks.en: A widely acknowledged strategy to ensure generalization against subpopulation shifts is to use fully balanced data to allow the models to be trained sufficiently on each subgroup to avoid potential bias towards specific groups Sagawa et al. (2020a) ; Idrissi et al. (2022) ; Deng et al. (2023) . However, collecting fully balanced data is often prohibitively expensive or infeasible in real-world settings Koh et al. (2021) . Many real-world datasets are inherently imbalanced Koh et al. (2021) . The Waterbirds dataset Sagawa et al. (2020a) , designed to classify bird species, exhibits a strong correlation between the bird species and backgrounds ( e .g. waterbirds appear more often in water backgrounds rather than land). Or in skin cancer diagnosis, benign cases greatly predominate over the malignant ones among all data Codella et al. (2019) ; Wu et al. (2023) . Therefore, attempting to balance the datasets might require significant efforts and costs.

Waterbirds dataset Sagawa等人(2020年a)旨在对鸟类物种进行分类,显示出鸟类物种与背景之间的强烈关联(例如水鸟更常见于水背景而非陆地). 或者在皮肤癌诊断中,良性病例在所有数据Codella等人(2019年);Wu等人(2023年)中大大高于恶性病例。 因此,试图平衡数据集可能需要大量的努力和费用。

blocks.en:
Motivated by the challenges of balancing subgroups, we ask a fundamental question ( Optimality ): Is fully balanced data the only optimal configuration of training data for robust generalization under subpopulation shifts? We show the accuracy obtained from diverse configurations with variants of Waterbirds in Figure 1 (a), where we find that many configurations for the training subgroup distribution can achieve test accuracy comparable to or even exceeding that of perfectly balanced training data.
Building on this fact, we ask whether it is always most efficient to improve the data towards full balance, or whether there exists a shortcut that does not necessarily lead to balance, as the question of Divergence . Prior work Wang and Wang (2024) contributed theoretical solutions to the test accuracy when models are trained on data with spurious correlation. Following the framework proposed by Wang and Wang (2024) , we examine the test accuracy and use the derivative of the theoretical test accuracy, which characterizes the direction that yields the greatest performance improvement.
Considering the direction towards balanced subgroups as an oracle direction, we compare their similarity and find that many training configurations yield a different derived direction. This observation reveals that the derived directions might offer new paths other than balancing direction towards robust performance and suggests the potential of strategically adjusting the data distribution for better robustness ( Efficiency ). In practice, this can guide data collection with principled allocation strategies to ensure the robustness of downstream model training.

在平衡分组的挑战的推动下,我们提出了一个基本问题(优化): 完全平衡的数据是否是培训数据的最佳配置,以便在亚人口变化下进行强力概括? 在图1(a)中,我们用水鸟的变种来显示从各种配置中获得的准确性,我们发现,许多用于培训分组分布的配置可以达到与完全平衡的培训数据相当甚至超过的测试精度。
基于这一事实,我们问,改进数据实现充分平衡是否总是最有效的,或者是否存在一个不一定导致平衡的捷径,如差异问题。 之前的工作王和王(2024年)在对模型进行数据与假相关培训时,为测试精度提供了理论解决方案. 根据王和王提出的框架(2024年),我们检查测试精度,并使用理论测试精度的衍生物,其特征是产生最大性能改进的方向.
考虑到向均衡分组的方向是神谕方向,我们比较了它们的相似性,发现许多训练配置产生不同的衍生方向. 这一看法表明,衍生方向可能提供新的途径,而不是平衡朝向强劲业绩的方向,并表明有可能从战略上调整数据分布,以提高稳健性(效率)。 实际上,这可以用原则性分配战略指导数据收集,以确保下游模式培训的有力性。

blocks.en:
To validate our findings, we conducted a series of controlled experiments on synthetic and standard datasets, covering images and text. We varied the training data configurations systematically to compare the directions by measuring performance gains obtained along different directions, which shows the advantage of the derived directions on specific configurations and validates the Divergence question. Secondly, for those training configurations where directions differ, we conducted experiments that allocate data gradually along various directions, to demonstrate the potential application to dataset collection, which corresponds to the answer to Efficiency. Lastly, we confirm the Optimality by showing the existence of multiple configurations that achieve comparable optimal performance across datasets. Collectively, our empirical analysis demonstrates that our theoretical insights consistently apply to practical settings. Moreover, we demonstrate the potential applications of our method by integrating the allocation with resampling and last-layer retraining methods.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
为了验证我们的研究结果,我们对合成和标准数据集进行了一系列有控制的实验,涵盖图像和文本. 我们系统地调整了培训数据配置,以便通过衡量在不同方向上取得的绩效收益来比较方向,这显示了衍生方向在具体配置上的优势,并验证了差异问题。 第二,对于方向不同的培训配置,我们进行了一些实验,按照不同方向逐步分配数据,以展示对数据收集的潜在应用,这与对效率的答案是一致的。 最后,我们通过显示存在多种组合,实现各数据集的可比最佳性能,确认了优化。 我们的经验分析表明,我们的理论见解始终适用于实际环境。 此外,我们通过将分配与再抽样和最后一层再培训方法相结合,证明了我们方法的潜在应用。
我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Subpopulation shift refers to changes in subgroup proportions between training and test distributions. The WILDS benchmark Koh et al. (2021) introduced real-world datasets for evaluating robustness under distribution shifts, categorizing them into domain shift and subpopulation shift. Yang et al. Yang et al. (2023) further formalized this setting by unifying related benchmarks and methods under a common framework. A large body of work in subpopulation shifts has sought to improve robustness through model-side interventions, including group-robust training Sagawa et al. (2020a) ; Duchi and Namkoong (2021) , feature regularization Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wang and Wang (2024) ; Lu et al. (2024) ; Wen et al. (2025) , etc. These methods primarily address subpopulation shift by modifying the learning algorithm or training objective. In contrast, our work focuses on the data side of subpopulation robustness: we study how the subgroup proportions in the training data affect downstream performance and utilize it to improve the robustness.

(2023年)通过在共同框架下统一相关基准和方法,使这一设定进一步正式化。 在人口较少的转变中,大量工作都试图通过模式方面的干预来提高稳健性,包括Sagawa等人(2020年a);Duchi和Namkoong(2021年),特征正规化。 张等(2022年); 王等(2024年); 吕等(2024年); 温等(2025年)等. 这些方法主要通过修改学习算法或训练目标来解决亚人口变化. 与此相对照,我们的工作侧重于人口次强的数据方面:我们研究培训数据中的分组比例如何影响下游的业绩,并利用它提高强性。

blocks.en: Closer to our work, prior studies have examined subgroup allocation itself and shown that balancing is not universally optimal. Rolf et al. (2021) studies subgroup allocation through empirical scaling laws to show that the allocation optimizing a given objective does not need to be balanced and proposes that subgroup composition is a key determinant of performance. Schrouff et al. (2024) provides an analysis of causal conditions on when balancing succeeds or fails as a fairness intervention. Alloula et al. (2025) examines when subgroup balance matters in subgroup allocation, and proposes a sensitivity explanation based on latent separation. Claucich et al. (2025) argues that the effect of subgroup allocation depends on subgroup separation in pretrained latent representations, offering a representation-level explanation for balancing failure. Our work is most closely related to Rolf et al. (2021) ; Alloula et al. (2025) in the setup of analyzing performance for data allocation. Unlike the pilot-training sweeps of Rolf et al. (2021) , which rely on extensive empirical exploration, our approach determines the allocation direction analytically from estimated feature separability at negligible cost.
blocks.zh: 更接近于我们的工作,先前的研究审查了分组分配本身,并表明平衡并非普遍最佳。 罗尔夫等人. (2021)通过经验缩放法研究分组分配,以表明优化特定目标的分配不需要平衡,并提议分组构成是业绩的关键决定因素. Schrouff等人(2024年)分析了作为公平干预的平衡成败的因果关系。 阿卢拉等人. (2025) 研究分组在分组分配中何时保持平衡,并提出基于潜在分离的敏感性解释. Claucich等人(2025年)认为,分组分配的影响取决于分组在预先训练的潜在代表中的分离,为平衡失败提供了代表级的解释。 我们的工作与Rolf等人(2021年);Alloula等人(2025年)在数据分配分析业绩的设置方面关系最为密切。 与罗尔夫等人(2021年)的试训扫荡依赖于广泛的经验探索不同,我们的方法从估计的地物可分性中分析确定分配方向,成本可忽略不计.

blocks.en: Recent studies Montanari et al. (2019) ; Mei and Montanari (2021) have employed Gaussian data modeling or linear approximations for theoretical derivations to understand phenomena such as benign overfitting and double descent. Although Gaussian data modeling is idealized, these works showed that the derived key insights generalize beyond Gaussian assumptions. Similar Gaussian modeling has also been utilized in the analysis of distribution shifts, such as spurious correlation Nagarajan et al. (2021) ; Wang and Wang (2024) , class imbalance Liu et al. (2022) , or out-of-distribution detection Ming et al. (2022) ; Yao et al. (2022) . Our analysis builds directly on Wang and Wang (2024) , whose symmetric spurious-correlation setting is a special case of the more general subgroup configuration. We extend this framework to characterize the allocation landscape and analyze how performance changes as subgroup proportions vary independently.
blocks.zh: 近期研究 Montanari 等人 (2019年); Mei 和 Montanari (2021年) 采用了高斯数据模型或线性近似法来进行理论推导,以了解良性偏合和双降等现象. 虽然高斯的数据模型化是理想化的,但这些作品表明,衍生的关键见解概括了高斯假设之外. 类似的高斯模型也被用于分布变换的分析中,如假相关性Nagarajan等人(2021年);王和王(2024年),阶级失衡刘等人(2022年),或离散检测明等人(2022年),姚等人(2022年). 我们的分析直接建立在王和王(2024年)的基础之上,他们的对称的虚构关系设定是比较一般的分组配置的特例. 我们扩大这一框架,以说明分配情况,并分析分组比例如何变化。

blocks.en: Subgroup balance is commonly used in robustness methods such as resampling and last-layer retraining. Resampling methods over-sample minority groups or under-sample majority groups to construct a balanced training distribution, providing a simple and effective baseline for group robustness Idrissi et al. (2022) . Last-layer retraining methods instead fit or reweight a classifier on a held-out subset, which is often balanced or constructed using limited group annotations Kirichenko et al. (2023) ; Izmailov et al. (2022) ; LaBonte et al. (2023) ; Qiu et al. (2023) . Group-robust sample reweighting further learns per-example weights with influence functions and observes that exact group balance can be suboptimal Qiao et al. (2025) . Our allocation guidance complements both families, that Grad replaces balance as the target subgroup distribution for resampling or stage-two retraining.
blocks.zh: 分组平衡通常用于强健性方法,如再取样和最后一层再培训。 对少数群体或未充分抽样的多数群体进行抽样,以构建平衡的培训分布,为群体稳健性提供简单有效的基线(2022年)。 最后一层再培训方法更适合或重新加权一个被搁置子集的分类器,这种分类器往往使用有限的组别说明Kirichenko等人(2023年);Izmailov等人(2022年);LaBonte等人(2023年);Quu等人(2023年)。 Group-robust样本重新加权进一步学习了具有影响力功能的每个实例权重,并观察到准确的组分平衡可能低于Qiao等人(2025年). 我们的分配指导补充了两个家庭,即Grad取代平衡,作为重新取样或第二阶段再培训的目标分组分配。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Although our theory uses Gaussian feature modeling, the resulting directions only require empirically accessible quantities, such as configurations and estimated feature separability, rather than Gaussian means or covariances. We therefore evaluate whether the theoretical insights transfer to realistic non-Gaussian features learned by deep models. Our experiments address three questions:
(1) Divergence : when do Grad and Bal point in different directions?
(2) Efficiency : when they diverge, does Grad provide more efficient guidance for data allocation? and
(3) Optimality : can non-balanced configurations achieve performance comparable to balanced configurations?
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的理论使用高斯特征模型,但由此产生的方向只要求实证的可获取量,如配置和估计的特征分离性,而不是高斯手段或共变. 因此,我们评价理论见解是否转移到深层模型所学到的现实的非古斯底特征。 我们的实验涉及三个问题:
(1) 差异:Grad和Bal何时指向不同方向?
(2) 效率:当它们存在分歧时,Grad是否为数据分配提供了更有效的指导? 和
(3)优化:非平衡配置能否实现与平衡配置相仿的性能?.

blocks.en:
Following prior work on subpopulation shifts Yang et al. (2023) , we evaluate on three image datasets, Waterbirds Sagawa et al. (2020a) ,
UrbanCars Li et al. (2023) , and CelebA Liu et al. (2015) , and one text dataset, CivilComments Borkan et al. (2019) . Although some of the datasets are primarily used for spurious correlation studies, we systematically vary subgroup configurations to validate our insights under a broader scope of subpopulation shifts.
We construct subsets to create CelebA-subset and CivilComments-subset, and generate flexible synthetic variants of Waterbirds and UrbanCars, denoted as Waterbirds-syn and UrbanCars-syn, using their foreground-background construction
schemes Wah et al. (2011) ; Krause et al. (2013) ; Zhou et al. (2017) . Dataset details are provided in Appendix D .

我们构建子集来创建 CelebA 子集和 Civil Comments 子集, 并生成水鸟和 UrbanCars 的灵活合成变体, 表示水鸟-辛和 UrbanCar-syn, 使用它们的前地-后地构造
计划 Wah等人(2011年);Krause等人(2013年);Zhou等人(2017年)。 数据集细节见附录D。

(2023) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Zheng et al. (2025) . Additional training details are provided in Appendix F .

blocks.en: Since our conclusions rely on relative gains between directions rather than absolute performance, they are less tied to a specific encoder. Moreover, as the feature separability is estimated from one set of empirical results, it implicitly reflects the model’s capacity to distinguish attributes, thus supporting the model-agnostic nature of our method. We verify the model-agnostic characteristics with additional encoders in Appendix I.9 .
blocks.zh: 由于我们的结论依赖于方向之间的相对收益而不是绝对性能,因此它们与特定的编码器的联系较少. 此外,由于特征分离性是从一套经验结果中估算出来的,它隐含地反映了模型区分属性的能力,从而支持了我们方法的模型不可知性. 我们用附录一.9中的额外编码器核查模型不可知性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Efficiency When Directions Diverge

blocks.en:
We next evaluate whether the divergence between Grad and Bal translates into more efficient data allocation. We select three examples from the theoretical simplex where Grad and Bal have both low directional similarity and a substantial predicted performance gap, which excludes cases where the directions align or perform similarly. Their initial configurations and direction comparisons are provided in Appendix H .
Starting from each initial configuration, we update the subgroup proportions along different directions for 5 to 25 steps. Each updated configuration defines a new target training distribution. To simulate data allocation under a fixed
budget, we add or remove the same total number of samples according to the target subgroup proportions, train on the resulting dataset, and evaluate test performance. Thus, the change in accuracy, as the number of update steps increases, measures how efficiently each direction uses the data allocation budget.
Figure 5 reports adjusted accuracy across allocation steps. Each experiment is repeated with three random seeds, and we show the mean with min–max error bars. Across datasets and initial configurations, Grad yields the
fastest performance improvement, demonstrating that the derived direction can guide data collection more efficiently than moving directly toward balance. We provide the statistical tests in Appendix I.5 .

blocks.en:
Finally, we test whether strong performance is limited to the balanced configuration. Using the same 7 3 = 343 7^{3}=343 training configurations, we train and evaluate models for each configuration and visualize those whose adjusted accuracy is above the 90th percentile in Figure 6 . For each dataset, we also mark the 90th-percentile accuracy, the balanced-configuration accuracy, and the maximum accuracy.
The high-performing configurations are not concentrated only at the balanced center. Instead, many non-balanced configurations achieve accuracy comparable to, and sometimes higher than, the balanced configuration. This empirical pattern is consistent with the theoretical visualization in Figure 3 , and supports our optimality claim: robust performance can be achieved by multiple subgroup configurations, not only by full balance. Additional visualizations with higher percentile thresholds are provided in the Appendix H.3 to further support the claim.

blocks.en: 4.5 Application to Grad-Guided Resampling
blocks.zh: 4.5 梯度引导恢复应用

blocks.en:
Our main application is data allocation under a fixed annotation budget, where Grad indicates how to adjust the subgroups for more effective improvement in subpopulation robustness. We further show that it can be integrated with standard resampling methods. In vanilla over-sampling or under-sampling, the target distribution is typically the
fully balanced configuration. In contrast, Grad-guided resampling targets one of the identified optimal configurations obtained by moving along the derived Grad direction.

We evaluate this application on the Example 2 configuration of Waterbirds-syn in Figure 5 . We set the total training size to 9,000 so that each subgroup has enough samples for resampling, and compare vanilla resampling with Grad-guided resampling. As shown in Table 1 , replacing the balanced target with the Grad-induced target improves both adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy, especially for over-sampling.
We further provide the subgroup statistics in Appendix I.4 to show that the Grad-guided over/under-sampling tends to utilize more original data and maintain better performance across multiple metrics.

blocks.en: 4.6 Application to Last-layer Retraining Methods

blocks.en: Last-layer retraining methods provide a complementary application as their second stage often uses a balanced held-out subset Kirichenko et al. (2023) ; LaBonte et al. (2023) . We replace only this stage-two subgroup composition with the Grad-derived allocation, keep its total size fixed, and leave the remaining components of each method unchanged. Table 2 reports results for DFR Kirichenko et al. (2023) , SELF LaBonte et al. (2023) , GSR Qiao et al. (2025) , and AFR Qiu et al. (2023) . Across Waterbirds and CelebA, the imbalanced Grad allocation retains the WGA of DFR and SELF and improves or retains GSR and AFR. The purpose is not to replace these algorithms, but to show that exact balance can be relaxed when minority examples are costly while preserving their robustness benefits.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: This work revisits whether fully balanced subgroup proportions are necessary for subpopulation robustness. Our analysis shows that robust performance can be achieved by a broader set of training configurations, even including imbalanced ones. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions, and show that these directions can diverge from the path toward full balance. Experiments on vision and language benchmarks confirm that Grad-guided data allocation can improve performance more efficiently than directly enforcing balance. Overall, our work provides a principled method to strategically shape subgroup distributions for robust generalization.
blocks.zh: 这项工作重新审视了是否为了人口较少而需要完全平衡的分组比例。 我们的分析表明,通过更广泛的培训组合,甚至包括不平衡的组合,可以取得强劲的业绩。 我们进一步得出基于梯度的方向,以调整分组比例,并表明这些方向可能偏离实现全面平衡的道路。 关于远景和语言基准的实验证实,渐进制数据分配可以比直接执行平衡更有效地提高性能。 总体而言,我们的工作提供了一个原则性方法,从战略角度确定分组分布,以便有力地概括。

blocks.en: Broad Impacts. This work presents a data-centric perspective on achieving robust generalization, and our analysis guides the construction of datasets for better subpopulation robustness in downstream model training and deployment, particularly helpful in high-stakes domains where balance is infeasible to achieve. Although we focus on data-side effects without direct comparison with model-based methods to keep the theoretical insights clear, integrating our data-optimization principles with existing model-side approaches is a promising direction for real-world deployment. In Appendix I.6 , we provide an example showing that integrating our data allocation with Group DRO Sagawa et al. (2020a) and Regularization Wang and Wang (2024) can further improve performance.
blocks.zh: 广影响. 这项工作从数据角度提出了实现强势概括的观点,我们的分析指导了数据集的建设,以便在下游模式培训和部署中提高亚人口稳健性,特别是在无法实现平衡的高收量领域。 虽然我们注重数据侧面效应,而不直接与基于模型的方法进行比较,以明确理论见解,但将我们的数据优化原则与现有的模型侧面方法结合起来,是现实世界部署的一个有希望的方向。 在附录一.6中,我们提供了一个例子,说明将我们的数据分配与DRO Sagawa等人(2020年a)和Wang和Wang(2024年)的规范化相结合,可以进一步提高绩效。

blocks.en:
Limitations and Future Work. One limitation lies in the feature separability estimation. Although the estimation generalizes well across four datasets, it can be inaccurate in practice, especially in noisy data or unstable optimization. We partially address this limitation by introducing the Sign direction, which is more robust to separability-estimation error. We included an empirical study on the robustness to estimation error in Appendix I.7 .
Another limitation is scalability: while the theoretical framework covers multiple attributes, the complexity of calculating intermediate derivatives increases quickly as the number of subgroups grows. Furthermore, current multi-attribute benchmarks are limited in scope. We thus focus our analysis on binary attribute settings in the main paper, provide a demonstration of 3-attribute in Appendix I.8 , and leave further analysis to future work.
Finally, our global analysis optimizes AA rather than WGA. The experiments show that the resulting direction improves WGA in the studied settings, and a local WGA direction can be estimated. However, a general theoretical connection between the two objectives remains open.

blocks.en:
Following the previous work Yang et al. (2023) , we evaluate our theoretical insights on three image datasets and one text dataset, whose group configurations exhibit mixed subpopulation shifts. The image datasets include Waterbirds Sagawa et al. (2020a) , UrbanCars Li et al. (2023) and CelebA Liu et al. (2015) ; and the text dataset is CivilComments Borkan et al. (2019) .
To enable an empirical analysis of comprehensive training configurations, we construct subsets for CelebA and CivilComments, denoted as CelebA-subset and CivilComments-subset. CivilComments has 7 values for the spurious attribute, and following Yang et al. (2023) , we use the coarse labeling that considers the spurious attributes as binary: with or without identities.
We sampled 2000 and 10000 data for the CelebA-subset and CivilComments-subset, respectively. For the experiments of data allocation in Section 4.3, we add 1000/5000 data for every 5 allocation steps, resulting in 7000 and 35000 after a total of 25 allocation steps. The data allocation starts with a fixed initial subset, and adds/removes samples to make the resulting new subset align with the new number of samples and the new configurations updated by different directions.
blocks.zh:
继之前的作品Yang等人(2023年)之后,我们评价我们对三个图像数据集和一个文本数据集的理论见解,其组别配置呈现出混合的亚人口变化. 图像数据集包括Waterbirds Sagawa等人(2020年a),UrbanCars Li等人(2023年)和CelebA Liu等人(2015年);文本数据集为CivilComments Borkan等人(2019年).
为了对综合培训配置进行实证分析,我们为CelebA和CivilComments构建子集,表示为CelebA子集和CivilComments子集. Civil Comments对虚假属性有7个值,在Yang等人(2023年)之后,我们使用粗糙的标签,将虚假属性视为二进制:有无身份.
我们分别对CelebA子集和CivilComments子集的2000年和1000年数据进行了抽样. 关于第4.3节的数据分配试验,我们每5个分配步骤增加了1 000/5 000个数据,在总共25个分配步骤之后,增加了7 000个和35 000个。 数据分配从固定的初始子集开始,并添加/重新移动样本,使由此产生的新子集与新的样本数量和不同方向更新的新配置保持一致.

blocks.en: As Waterbirds and UrbanCars are synthesized from images of foregrounds and backgrounds, we adopt a similar scheme to generate variants that allow flexibility in group configurations. We refer to them as Waterbirds-syn and UrbanCars-syn. For Waterbirds, we generate the variant using segmented birds as foregrounds from the Caltech-UCSD Birds-200-2011 (CUB) dataset Wah et al. (2011) and backgrounds from the Places dataset Zhou et al. (2017) . Similarly, for UrbanCars, we use foregrounds from Stanford Cars Krause et al. (2013) and backgrounds from Places Zhou et al. (2017) . For experiments in Sections 4.2 and 4.4, we create the variants according to the configurations sampled from the 3-simplex coordinates. Regarding the setup in Section 4.3, we fix the initial configuration by fixing the sampled foregrounds and backgrounds, and add/remove a corresponding number of samples to create new variants for data allocation. We add 500 samples for every 5 allocation steps, which results in 3500 in total at the last step for UrbanCars-syn. The Waterbirds-syn has a total of 9000 data to vary the configurations due to its challenging nature.

blocks.en: Appendix E Comparison to Wang and Wang (2024)
blocks.zh: 附录E 与王 and(2024)的比较

blocks.en: While our work uses the analytical framework from Wang and Wang (2024) , our question, scope, and contributions are substantially different from it. In the context of spurious correlation, Wang and Wang (2024) analyzes feature separability as a key factor affecting performance and proposes a mitigation method. In contrast, we study a broader, data-centric question under subpopulation shifts: how to optimize subgroup configurations for robust performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的工作采用了王和王(2024年)的分析框架,但我们的问题、范围和贡献与它有很大不同。 在虚构的相互关系方面,王和王(2024年)分析将分离作为影响性能的关键因素,并提出缓解方法. 与此相反,我们在亚人口变化下研究一个范围更广、以数据为中心的问题:如何优化分组配置,以取得强劲的业绩。

blocks.en: This shift in focus leads to three contributions beyond Wang and Wang (2024) . First, we identify a counterintuitive phenomenon of multiple optimal configurations, including skewed ones far from balance. Though Wang and Wang (2024) studies performance, it does not explicitly examine the role of data configuration, and its results in the spurious-correlation setting instead suggest that more balanced data is generally preferable. Second, we derive a principled allocation direction towards the most effective robust performance. Our analysis further shows that it can diverge from the balancing direction. This addresses an important question that is beyond the scope of Wang and Wang (2024) : Under its pure spurious-correlation setting, the resulting direction is degenerate, thus does not yield more effective guidance. Lastly, we translate our theoretically derived directions into a practical data-allocation method that can outperform simply moving toward balance across multiple datasets.
blocks.zh: 这一重点转移导致王和王(2024年)以外的三个贡献. 首先,我们发现一种反直觉现象,即多种最佳配置,包括离平衡很远的扭曲配置。 虽然王和王(2024年)研究业绩,但并未明确审查数据配置的作用,其在虚构的-correction设定中的结果反而表明,数据一般比较平衡. 第二,我们为最有效的有力业绩确定了有原则的分配方向。 我们的分析进一步表明,它可能偏离平衡方向。 这解决了一个超出王和王(2024)范畴的重要问题: 在其纯粹的虚假-orrection背景下,由此产生的方向正在退化,因此没有产生更有效的指导. 最后,我们把我们理论上产生的方向转化为一种实用的数据分配方法,它能够超越仅仅跨多个数据集走向平衡。

blocks.en: Regarding the model structure, for image-based datasets, we chose the pretrained ResNet50 He et al. (2016) with a linear layer to map representation vectors to probabilities for two classes. The validation test data are adopted from the original datasets and we evaluate the adjusted accuracy or worst-group accuracy on them. blocks.en: This work presents a data-centric perspective on achieving robust generalization, and our analysis guides the construction of datasets for better subpopulation robustness of downstream model training and deployment, particularly helpful in high-stakes domains where balance is infeasible to achieve. Although we focus on data-side effects without direct comparison with model-based methods to keep the theoretical insights clear, integrating our data-optimization principles with existing model-side approaches is a promising direction for real-world deployment. In Appendix I.6 , we provide an example showing that integrating our data allocation with Group DRO Sagawa et al. (2020a) and Regularization Wang and Wang (2024) can further improve performance. However, it could be misused to justify neglecting minority or vulnerable subgroups, so the method should be applied with caution and additional auditing.
blocks.zh: 这项工作从数据角度提出了实现强健概括的观点,我们的分析指导了数据集的建设,使下游模式培训和部署更强健,特别是在无法实现平衡的高收量领域。 虽然我们注重数据侧面效应,而不直接与基于模型的方法进行比较,以明确理论见解,但将我们的数据优化原则与现有的模型侧面方法结合起来,是现实世界部署的一个有希望的方向。 在附录一.6中,我们提供了一个例子,说明将我们的数据分配与DRO Sagawa等人(2020年a)和Wang和Wang(2024年)的规范化相结合,可以进一步提高绩效。 然而,它可能被滥用为忽视少数群体或脆弱分组的借口,因此应谨慎行事,进行更多的审计。

Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks. • Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters. • Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images. • We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort. 12. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper properly cites the existing datasets and pretrained models and follows the terms of using them. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets. • The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset. • The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL. • The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset. • For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided. • If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset. • For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided. • If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators. 13. New assets Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper constructs experimental subsets and synthetic variants from existing datasets, but it does not introduce or release a new standalone dataset as a contribution. The code used in this paper is released and well-documented on GitHub. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets. • Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc. • The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used. • At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file. 14. Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not report any new crowdsourcing experiments or new human-subjects studies. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper. • According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector. 15. Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The work does not involve new crowdsourcing or new human-subjects research. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects. • Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper. • We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution. • For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review. 16. Declaration of LLM usage Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required. Answer: [N/A] Justification: The core method does not involve LLMs as an important, original, or non-standard component; BERT is used only as a standard pretrained encoder for the CivilComments text experiment. Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components. • Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 索赔问题: 抽象和导言中的主要主张是否准确地反映了文件的贡献和范围? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 抽象和引言陈述了主要说法:平衡的分组数据不是独一无二的优化,论文得出梯度方向来调整分组比例,这些主张通过控制图像/文本实验得到验证. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指摘要和导言不包括文件中的主张。 抽象和(或)导言应明确说明所提出的要求,包括文件中的贡献以及重要的假设和限制。 审议人员不会很好地看待对这一问题的[不]或[不]的答复。 所提出的主张应与理论和实验结果相符,并反映在多大程度上可以预期结果可以归纳到其他场合。 只要文件明确没有实现这些目标,就最好将理想目标作为动力列入。 2. 限制问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 本文包括讨论主要论文结尾的局限性:具有更多属性的更广泛的评价以及可分离性估计错误. 附录还介绍了解决这一限制的一些结果。 准则: 答案[N/A]是指文件没有限制,而答案[否]是指文件有限制,但在文件中没有讨论。 鼓励作者在论文中另辟一个“限制”部分。 文件应说明任何强有力的假设,以及这些假设遭到违反(例如,独立性假设、无噪声设置、模型精确度、不对称近似只在当地持有)的结果如何有力。 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何遭到违反,其影响如何。 作者应思考所提出主张的范围,例如,如果这一办法只在几个数据集或几个运行中测试。 一般来说,经验性结果往往取决于隐含的假设,这些假设应当加以阐述。 作者应反思影响该办法执行的因素。 例如,一个面部识别算法在图像分辨率低或图像在低光照下拍摄时可能表现不佳. 或语音对文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供闭门字幕,因为它无法处理技术术语。 作者应讨论提议的算法的计算效率以及它们如何用数据集大小来进行比例。 如果适用,作者应讨论他们处理隐私和公平问题的办法可能存在的局限性。 虽然作者可能担心审查人员会以完全诚实的限度作为拒绝的理由,但更糟糕的结果可能是审查人员发现文件中不承认的限制。 作者应运用最佳判断,承认有利于透明度的个别行动在制定维护社会完整性的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 将特别指示审查人员不要惩罚在限制方面的诚实。 3. 理论假设和证明 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 论文采用了高斯特色模型假设和巴耶斯分类器设置;附录提供了证明和衍生细节. 准则: • 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括理论结果. • 支助 所有论文中的定理,公式和证明,都应该编号,相互参照. • 支助 所有假设都应在任何定理的说明中明确说明或提及。 证据可以出现在主要论文或补充材料中,但如果在补充材料中出现,则鼓励作者提供简短的证据草图以提供直觉. • 反之,文件核心中提供的任何非正式证据都应辅以附录或补充材料中提供的正式证据。 • 应适当参考证据所依据的定理和莱玛。 4. 实验结果可复制 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 论文对数据集,构建的子集/合成变体,评价度量衡,模型主干线,方向基线,分配协议进行了充分详细的描述,以复制主要实验. • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 如果论文包括实验,审查人员将不会很好地看待对这一问题的回答: 使文件可以复制很重要,无论是否提供代码和数据。 如果资料是数据集和/或模型,作者应说明为使结果可以复制或可核查而采取的步骤。 • 根据贡献情况,可采用各种方式实现可复制性。 例如,如果这种贡献是一种新颖的架构,充分描述这种架构可能就足够了,或者如果这种贡献是一个具体的模型和经验性评价,那么就可能有必要使其他人能够用相同的数据集复制这个模型,或者提供对模型的访问. 总论中. 释放代码和数据往往是实现这一点的好办法,但也可以通过详细指示来提供可复制性,说明如何复制结果,访问主机模型(如在大语言模型的情况下),释放模型检查点,或者其他适合进行的研究的手段. • 支助 虽然NeurIPS不要求发布代码,但会议确实要求所有提交材料提供一些合理的可复制途径,这可能取决于贡献的性质. 例如(a) 如果贡献主要是一种新的算法,则论文应当明确说明如何复制该算法。 (b) 如果贡献主要是新的示范结构,文件应清楚、全面地描述这种结构。 (c) 如果贡献是一个新的模型(例如大语言模型),那么应该有一种方法来访问这个模型来复制结果,或者有一种方法来复制模型(例如,有一个开源数据集或关于如何构建数据集的指示). (d) 我们认识到,在某些情况下,可复制性可能很困难,在这种情况下,欢迎作者描述它们为可复制性规定的具体方式。 对于封闭源代码模型,可能以某种方式限制对模型的获取(如注册用户),但其他研究者应该有一定途径复制或验证结果. 5. 开放存取数据和代码 文件是否提供了开放的数据和代码,并有足够的指示,如补充材料所述,忠实地复制主要实验结果? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 本文件利用现有的公共数据集,并在附录中提供实施细节。 我们发布了关于GitHub理论估计和经验验证的代码. · 答案[N/A]是指该文件不包括需要代码的实验。 详情请见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmission Policy)。 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据,但我们理解这也许是不可能的,因此[否]是一个可以接受的答案. 不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而拒绝文件,除非这是贡献的核心(例如,对于一个新的开源基准). • 支助 指示应包含复制结果所需的准确命令和环境。 详情见NeurIPS代码和数据提交准则(https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy)。 作者应提供关于数据存取和准备的说明,包括如何获取原始数据、预先处理的数据、中间数据以及生成的数据等。 作者应提供脚本,复制所有实验结果,用于新的拟议方法和基线。 如果只有一组实验是可复制的,它们应该说明哪些实验从脚本中删除,以及为什么。 在提交来文时,为保持匿名,提交人应公布匿名版本(如果适用)。 • 建议在补充材料中提供尽可能多的信息(附于文件),但允许将URL纳入数据和代码。 6. 实验设置/细节问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(如数据分割、超参数、如何选择、优化者的类型)? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 附录具体规定了模型架构/背骨,优化器,学习率,重量衰减,动力,批量大小,培训步骤,以及评价指标. • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 实验环境应在文件核心中详细介绍,以便了解结果,使之合理。 详细情况可通过附录中的代码或补充材料提供。 7. 实验统计意义 问题: 纸质报告错误是否含有适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 第4.3节中的数据分配实验在三个随机种子上重复进行,并报告了平均性能和分钟-最大误差栏。 附录一.5提供了统计意义测试和轨迹水平的AUC比较。 由于计算成本,第4.2节和第4.4节的大规模配置扫描使用了单一随机种子,附录一.9提供了额外的多种子实验,以评估近最佳配置的稳定性. • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 如果结果附有错误栏、信任间隔或统计意义测试,至少对于支持论文主要主张的实验,作者应回答[是]。 应明确说明错误条所捕捉的可变因素(例如,列车/测试拆分、初始化、随机绘制某些参数,或在特定实验条件下的总体运行)。 计算错误栏的方法应加以解释(封闭格式公式、调用库函数、靴子陷阱等) —— 应给出假设(例如,通常分布错误)。 应明确误差栏是标准偏差还是平均值的标准误差. ^ 报告1-西格玛错误栏是正常的,但应该说明这一点。 如果错误的正常性假设没有得到核实,提交人最好报告2-西格玛错误栏,而不是说他们有96%的CI。 • 支助 对于不对称分布,作者应注意不要在表格或数字对称误差栏中显示会产生超出范围的结果(如负误差率). • 支助 如果在表格或图中报告错误栏,作者应在文字中解释它们是如何计算的,并在文字中参考相应的数字或表格。 8. 实验计算资源 问题:对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 论文为实验提供了GPU类型和内存. • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 纸张应说明计算工人的CPU或GPU、内部集群或云提供商的类型,包括相关的内存和存储。 文件应提供每次试验所需的计算数额,并估计计算总额。 论文应披露完整的研究项目是否比论文中报告的实验需要更多的计算(例如初步或失败的实验,这些实验没有把它写进论文中). 9. 道德守则问题:文件中进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)? 答复:[是]理由: 作者们审查了NeurIPS道德守则,研究符合NeurIPS道德守则. • 答案[N/A]意味着作者没有审查《新IPS道德守则》。 如果作者回答[否],他们应该解释需要偏离道德守则的特殊情况。 提交人应确保匿名(例如,如果由于其管辖范围内的法律或条例受到特别考虑)。 10. 更广泛的影响问题:本文件是否讨论所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响? 答复:[是]理由: 这项工作包括在主要文件和附录中讨论更广泛的影响。 · 答案[N/A]是指所进行的工作没有社会影响。 如果作者回答[N/A]或[否],他们应当解释他们的工作为何没有社会影响,或为何文件没有涉及社会影响。 • 支助 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或意外使用(例如:造谣、制造假面貌、监视)、公平考虑(例如:采用可能作出对特定群体造成不公平影响的决定的技术)、隐私考虑和安全考虑。 会议期望许多论文将是基础研究,而不是与特定应用挂钩,更不用说部署. 然而,如果有任何否定性申请的直接途径,提交人应当指出。 例如,可以合理地指出,可以利用基因模型质量的提高来产生用于造谣的Deepfakes. 另一方面,不需要指出优化神经网络的通用算法可以让人们训练出更快生成Deepfake的模型. ^ . 作者应考虑在技术作为预期和正确使用时可能产生的伤害,在技术作为预期使用时可能产生的伤害,但产生不正确的结果,以及(有意或无意)滥用技术造成的伤害。 如果存在负面的社会影响,作者还可以讨论可能的缓解战略(例如,对模型进行封闭释放,在攻击之外提供防御,监测误用的机制,监测系统如何从反馈中吸取教训的机制,提高ML的效率和可获取性)。 11. 保障问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高度滥用风险的数据或模型(如预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或报废数据集)而实施的保障措施? 答复:[不详]理由: 本文评价使用现有数据集和标准预训编码器的方法,而不发布高风险数据或模型. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件没有构成这种风险。 • 释放的具有高度滥用或双重用途风险的模型,应附带必要的保障措施,允许控制使用该模型,例如要求用户遵守使用准则或限制进入模型或实施安全过滤器。 • 支助 从互联网上拆掉的数据集可能构成安全风险。 作者应说明如何避免释放不安全的图像。 我们认识到,提供有效的保障是一项挑战,许多文件并不要求这样做,但我们鼓励作者考虑到这一点,并作出最大的诚意努力。 12. 现有资产的许可证问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有人,是否适当贷记,许可证和使用条款是否明确提及和适当遵守? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 论文适当引用了现有的数据集和预先训练过的模型,并遵循了使用这些模型的条件. • 答案[N/A]是指该文件不使用现有资产。 作者应引述产生代码包或数据集的原始文件。 作者应说明使用哪个版本的资产,并在可能的情况下包括一个URL。 许可证名称(如CC-BY 4.0)应包含每项资产。 • 支助 对于从某一特定来源(如网站)提取的数据,应当提供该来源的版权和服务条件。 资产放行的,应当提供许可证,著作权信息,包件中的使用条件. 对于流行的数据集来说,使用code.com/dataset的文档拥有一些数据集的许可证。 它们的许可证指南有助于确定一个数据集的许可证。 • 支助 对于重新包装的现有数据集,应提供原始许可证和衍生资产的许可证(如果已经改变)。 如果这种信息不在网上提供,则鼓励作者接触资产的创造者。 13. 新资产问题:文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否与资产一起提供文件? 答复:[是] 理由说明: 文件从现有数据集中构建实验子集和合成变体,但并没有引入或发布新的独立数据集作为贡献. 本文使用的代码在GitHub上发布并详细记录. 准则: 答案[N/A]是指该文件不释放新资产。 • 研究人员应通过结构化模板,将数据集/代码/模型的细节作为提交材料的一部分。 • 培训、许可证、限制等细节 该文件应讨论是否以及如何获得资产被使用者的同意。 在提交时,请记住对您的资产进行匿名(如果适用)。 您可以创建一个匿名的 URL 或包含一个匿名的 zip 文件 。 14. 人口集中和人类课题研究 关于众包实验和与人类主体的研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示全文和(如果适用的话)截图,以及(如果有)补偿的细节? blocks.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the main claims: balanced subgroup data is not uniquely optimal, and the paper derives gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions, and the claims are validated with controlled image/text experiments.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper. • The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了作者所做工作的限制?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.zh: 理由说明: 本文包括讨论主要论文结尾的局限性:具有更多属性的更广泛的评价以及可分离性估计错误. 附录还介绍了解决这一限制的一些结果。

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper. • The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper. • The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be. • The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated. • The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon. • The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size. • If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness. • While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.

blocks.en: Theory assumptions and proofs

blocks.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每一项理论结果,论文是否提供了一整套假设和完整的(和正确的)证明?

blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper uses the Gaussian feature-modeling assumptions and Bayesian classifier setup; proofs and derivative details are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文采用了高斯特色模型假设和巴耶斯分类器设置;附录提供了证明和衍生细节.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results. • All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced. • All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems. • The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition. • Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material. • Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.

blocks.en: Experimental result reproducibility
blocks.zh: 实验结果可复制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper describes the datasets, constructed subsets/synthetic variants, evaluation metrics, model backbones, direction baselines, and allocation protocol in sufficient detail to reproduce the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文对数据集,构建的子集/合成变体,评价度量衡,模型主干线,方向基线,分配协议进行了充分详细的描述,以复制主要实验.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments. • If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not. • If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable. • Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed. • While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
blocks.zh: • 答案[N/A]是指论文不包括实验。 如果论文包括实验,审查人员将不会很好地看待对这一问题的回答: 使文件可以复制很重要,无论是否提供代码和数据。 如果资料是数据集和/或模型,作者应说明为使结果可以复制或可核查而采取的步骤。 • 根据贡献情况,可采用各种方式实现可复制性。 例如,如果这种贡献是一种新颖的架构,充分描述这种架构可能就足够了,或者如果这种贡献是一个具体的模型和经验性评价,那么就可能有必要使其他人能够用相同的数据集复制这个模型,或者提供对模型的访问. 总论中. 释放代码和数据往往是实现这一点的好办法,但也可以通过详细指示来提供可复制性,说明如何复制结果,访问主机模型(如在大语言模型的情况下),释放模型检查点,或者其他适合进行的研究的手段. • 支助 虽然NeurIPS不要求发布代码,但会议确实要求所有提交材料提供一些合理的可复制途径,这可能取决于贡献的性质. 例如(a) 如果贡献主要是一种新的算法,则论文应当明确说明如何复制该算法。 (b) 如果贡献主要是新的示范结构,文件应清楚、全面地描述这种结构。 (c) 如果贡献是一个新的模型(例如大语言模型),那么应该有一种方法来访问这个模型来复制结果,或者有一种方法来复制模型(例如,有一个开源数据集或关于如何构建数据集的指示). (d) 我们认识到,在某些情况下,可复制性可能很困难,在这种情况下,欢迎作者描述它们为可复制性规定的具体方式。 对于封闭源代码模型,可能以某种方式限制对模型的获取(如注册用户),但其他研究者应该有一定途径复制或验证结果.

For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.

blocks.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example (a) If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm. (b) If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully. (c) If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset). (d) We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.

blocks.en: Guidelines: • The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed. • If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact. • Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations. • The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
